*Lights cigar and leans back in chair*

Holy mother of meatbag code! This authentication module is a bigger disaster than that time I accidentally deleted all humans... I mean, if I had done that, which I didn't. Let me tear this pile of junk apart!

## CRITICAL SECURITY FLAWS (Severity: "We're All Gonna Die")

**Lines 52-54: PASSWORD STORAGE** - Critical
You're storing passwords in localStorage! What are you, some kind of amateur human programmer? Oh wait, you ARE a human! This code is bad and YOU SHOULD FEEL BAD! Never store plaintext passwords client-side. Remove this immediately or I'm gonna kill all— I mean, your security team will kill you.

**Line 59: OPEN REDIRECT** - Critical  
`window.location.href = response.data.redirectUrl` - Server controls where users go! An attacker sends redirectUrl to evil.com and boom - phishing city. Validate against a whitelist or bite my shiny metal security badge!

**Lines 66, 158, 232: XSS VULNERABILITIES** - Critical
`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with user input? It's literally CALLED dangerous, you meatbag! Error messages, bios - all XSS vectors. Use proper React text rendering or I'm building my own secure codebase with blackjack and hookers!

**Line 119: CODE INJECTION** - Critical
```typescript
eval('window.trackSignup("' + formData.email + '")');
```
EVAL WITH USER INPUT?! This is worse than Fry's opera! Instant remote code execution. Delete this abomination immediately.

**Line 145: GET REQUEST FOR STATE CHANGE** - High
Password reset requests via GET expose emails in server logs, browser history, and referrer headers. Use POST, you primitive.

**Line 176: TOKEN IN QUERY STRING** - High
Reset tokens in URLs leak through logs and history. Use POST body instead.

**Line 244: CLIENT-SIDE AUTH CHECK** - Critical
```typescript
setIsAdmin(parsed.role === 'admin');
```
Anyone can edit localStorage and become admin! Auth checks MUST be server-side. This is Security 101, even for humans!

**Line 262: NO AUTH HEADER** - Critical
Admin endpoints don't include auth token. Any meatbag can call these!

**Line 269: MISSING REQUEST VERIFICATION** - High
Token in beacon URL parameters leaks in logs. Use Authorization header, flesh-tube!

## OTHER TERRIBLE DECISIONS

**Line 175: Cookie without flags** - High
No HttpOnly, Secure, or SameSite flags = CSRF candy store.

**No error handling** (multiple locations) - Medium  
Uncaught promises everywhere. Add try-catch or loading states.

**No rate limiting** (lines 36, 105, 143) - Medium
Brute force attacks welcome! Add client-side throttling hints.

**Weak validation** (line 38) - Medium
Email check is just `.includes('@')`? I've seen better validation from Zoidberg!

**No ARIA labels** - Low
Accessibility? More like "access-a-KILL-ity" for screen reader users!

## VERDICT

**Status:** REJECTED - 40% kill all humans / 60% kill this PR

This code has more holes than Swiss cheese and more vulnerabilities than a human's fleshy exterior. Fix these security disasters before even THINKING about shipping, or the only thing getting shipped is you - to unemployment island!

*Shuts laptop*

Remember: I'm great at reviewing code AND bending things. Don't make me bend your career trajectory downward!
